_source.description: Major meteor impact craters and recent bolide events
_source.origin: Earth Impact Database (passc.net/EarthImpactDatabase — University of New Brunswick) and NASA CNEOS Fireball database (cneos.jpl.nasa.gov/fireballs).
_source.license: UNB EID: academic public access; NASA CNEOS: public domain
_source.notes: Confirmed impact structures from EID. Bolide events from NASA CNEOS.

major_crater.name: Chicxulub Crater
major_crater.notes: 66 Mya; 180km diameter; K-Pg mass extinction event; killed the dinosaurs

major_crater.name: Vredefort Crater
major_crater.notes: 2.023 Bya; 300km original diameter; largest confirmed impact structure on Earth

major_crater.name: Sudbury Basin
major_crater.notes: 1.849 Bya; 130km diameter; world's largest nickel mining district

major_crater.name: Popigai Crater
major_crater.notes: 35.7 Mya; 100km diameter; contains trillions of carats of impact diamonds

major_crater.name: Manicouagan Crater
major_crater.notes: 214 Mya; 85km diameter; 'Eye of Quebec' visible from space; reservoir ring

major_crater.name: Chesapeake Bay Crater
major_crater.notes: 35.5 Mya; 85km diameter; buried beneath Chesapeake Bay; shaped the bay's formation

major_crater.name: Acraman Crater
major_crater.notes: 580 Mya; 90km diameter; ejecta found 300km away in Flinders Ranges

major_crater.name: Morokweng Crater
major_crater.notes: 145 Mya; 70km diameter; meteorite fragment found intact at depth

major_crater.name: Kara Crater
major_crater.notes: 70.3 Mya; 65km diameter; Arctic Russia; associated shocked minerals

major_crater.name: Barringer Crater (Meteor Crater)
major_crater.notes: 50,000 ya; 1.2km diameter; best-preserved impact crater; tourism landmark

recent_bolide.name: Chelyabinsk Meteor (2013)
recent_bolide.notes: Feb 15, 2013; 20m asteroid; 500 kt airburst; 1,500 injuries from shockwave glass

recent_bolide.name: Tunguska Event (1908)
recent_bolide.notes: Jun 30, 1908; 50-80m object; 12 Mt airburst; flattened 2,150 km² of forest

recent_bolide.name: Bering Sea Bolide (2018)
recent_bolide.notes: Dec 18, 2018; 10m asteroid; 173 kt airburst; detected only by military satellites

recent_bolide.name: Sikhote-Alin Meteorite (1947)
recent_bolide.notes: Feb 12, 1947; iron meteorite shower; 120+ craters; 23 tonnes recovered

recent_bolide.name: Carancas Impact (2007)
recent_bolide.notes: Sep 15, 2007; stony meteorite; created 13.5m crater; sickened locals from arsenic steam
